name: Smart Adhesive Gel
description: An adhesive that bonds on command and releases on command, mimicking gecko foot pads at the nanoscale. Smart adhesive gel holds components in place during assembly, bonds panels during construction, and enables climbing gear that grips any surface. Activation and release are triggered by UV light, temperature, or electrical signal.
